svg.title: Textile worker — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as textile worker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A sewing needle has an elongated eye and one long shaft, threaded with a loose looping strand. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
